codeLivewirePhp:
<?php

namespace App\Livewire;

use DateTimeImmutable;
use DateTimeZone;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class LiveQuotingComposer extends Component
{
    public string $from = '2026-12-23';
    public string $through = '2026-12-28';
    public string $part = 'Full';
    #[Locked] public int $available = 120;
    #[Locked] public bool $submitted = false;

    private function quote(): array
    {
        $zone = new DateTimeZone('UTC');
        $first = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $this->from, $zone);
        $last = DateTimeImmutable::createFromFormat('!Y-m-d', $this->through, $zone);
        if (!$first || !$last || $first->format('Y-m-d') !== $this->from || $last->format('Y-m-d') !== $this->through
            || $last < $first || $first->diff($last)->days > 365 || !in_array($this->part, ['Full', 'AM', 'PM'], true)) {
            return [];
        }
        $days = [];
        for ($date = $first; $date <= $last; $date = $date->modify('+1 day')) {
            $iso = $date->format('Y-m-d');
            $label = match (true) {
                in_array($iso, ['2026-12-25', '2027-01-01'], true) => 'Holiday excluded',
                in_array($date->format('N'), ['5', '6'], true) => 'Weekend excluded',
                default => 'Working',
            };
            $days[] = ['date' => $iso, 'label' => $label, 'hours' => $label === 'Working' ? ($this->part === 'Full' ? 8 : 4) : 0];
        }
        return $days;
    }

    public function updated(string $property): void
    {
        if (in_array($property, ['from','through','part'], true)) $this->submitted = false;
    }

    public function reserve(): void
    {
        $total = array_sum(array_column($this->quote(), 'hours'));
        if ($this->submitted || $total < 1 || $total > $this->available) return;
        $this->available -= $total;
        $this->submitted = true;
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        $days = $this->quote();
        return view('livewire.live-quoting-composer', ['days' => $days, 'total' => array_sum(array_column($days, 'hours')),
            'overlap' => $days && $this->from <= '2026-12-30' && $this->through >= '2026-12-28']);
    }
}
